method: Same analytic Ground.height, source DEM and source road profile. Only 20m corridor cells with centre <32m from the source road are refined to 4m, outside existing DETAIL. Compare actual old20/new4 triangle interpolants at 4m offset-grid samples, not surveyed accuracy. Stitching compares both sides at ±1e-6 m. Asphalt clearance sampled at <=0.5m along rounded visual centreline, using upper asphalt at overlaps; does not prove every shoulder pixel.
